scenario.note: The overmanned workforce in year 2 is limited to 80% of the overmanned workforce in year 1.
A rule that enforces the overmanned workers in year 2 to be at least 60% of the total overmanned workers across all years.
Two relative limits: workforce in year 1 is at most 75% of workforce in year 3; total short-time working is at most 25% of total retrained workers.
A rule that limits the short-time working in year 1 to 25% of that in year 3.
Rules enforce relative limits on the total workers on short-time working and the total workers employed above requirements compared to the total workers made redundant.
A rule that enforces the short-time working in year 2 to be at least 3 times that of year 1.
A rule that limits the sum of redundant workers in year 1 to be at most 1.5 times the sum in year 2.
The scenario adjusts the required workforce and recruitment limits for skilled and unskilled workers in specific years.
A rule that limits the sum of redundant workers in year 3 to at most 60% of the sum in year 2.
A rule that enforces the retrainings to skilled level are at least twice the retrainings to semi-skilled level.
Limits the proportion of short-time workers at the unskilled skill level to 10% of the total short-time workers.
A rule limits the sum of redundancies in year 3 to 15% of the total redundancies across all years.
The overmanned workers for semi_skilled must be at least 50% of the overmanned workers for unskilled.
A rule that enforces the overmanned workers at semi_skilled level to be at least 50% of the total overmanned workers across all skill levels.
A rule that limits the sum of redundant workers in year 2 to at most 25% of the sum in year 1.
Rules bound the SUM of a decision measure over a scope; a relative rule compares two such sums.
The rule limits the short-time workers at the skilled level to at most 5% of all short-time workers across all skill levels.
The rule limits the short-time workers at the semi-skilled level to at most 5% of all short-time workers across all skill levels.

The scenario sets the required workers for unskilled in year 2 and 3 to 700, and max recruit for semi-skilled in each year to 1000. It also ensures that at least 60% of the total workers recruited go to year 3.
The short-time working in year 1 is limited to 25% of the total short-time working in years 2 and 3.
